title: The Cascading Waterfalls of Ri Hynniewtrep (Ki Kshaid Barymphum)
cultural_context: Poetic hymn praising the legendary waterfalls of Meghalaya—Nohkalikai, Dainthlen, Nohsngithiang (Seven Sisters), Kshaid Weinia, and Elephant Falls. Celebrates the roaring cascades plunging off sandstone precipices into deep turquoise pools, shrouded in rainbow mist (barymphum) and eternal legends.
lyrics_khasi:
Na ki riat ba jrong ki kshaid ki la noh,
Kum ki paila rupa ki jaw ruid ruid;
Ka Nohkalikai ka kynih ha ka them,
Ka Dainthlen ka phet ha ki mawsiang ba khraw!

Ki barymphum ksiar ki ieng ha ka suin,
Ka lyer ka pynkhih ia ka jingshai ka sngi;
Ki um ba kordor ki pynim ia ka ri,
Ka nam jong ki kshaid kan neh ha la tnum!
lyrics_english:
From dizzying rocky precipices the waterfalls plunge,
Like cascading necklaces of shimmering silver beads;
Nohkalikai thunders into the deep forested basin,
Dainthlen races across ancient flat river boulders!

Rainbows of shimmering gold arch across the misty air,
The mountain breeze dances with the sunlight;
These precious living waters sustain our entire land,
The renown of these cataracts shall endure forever!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingjaw ki Paila Rupa (Silver Cascades)
stanzas.khasi:
Na ki riat ba jrong ki kshaid ki la noh,
Kum ki paila rupa ki jaw ruid ruid;
Ka Nohkalikai ka kynih ha ka them,
Ka Dainthlen ka phet ha ki mawsiang ba khraw!
stanzas.english: From high cliffs cascades plunge like strands of silver beads; Nohkalikai roars in the gorge, Dainthlen rushes over great stone beds!

stanzas.title: U Barymphum ha ka Suin (Rainbow in the Sky)
stanzas.khasi:
Ki barymphum ksiar ki ieng ha ka suin,
Ka lyer ka pynkhih ia ka jingshai ka sngi;
Ki um ba kordor ki pynim ia ka ri,
Ka nam jong ki kshaid kan neh ha la tnum!
stanzas.english: Golden rainbows stand in mist; winds dance with the sun's light. Precious waters revive our land; their glory endures forever!

vocabulary.barymphum: Rainbow created by water droplets in waterfall mist or rainfall
vocabulary.paila rupa: Beaded silver traditional necklace worn by Khasi women during festivals
vocabulary.nohkalikai: The celebrated 1,115-foot plunge waterfall near Sohra, named after Ka Likai
vocabulary.dainthlen: Sacred waterfall where ancestral warriors slew the monstrous thlen serpent
